project_type: Laravel 11 + PHP 8.4 monolith with Blade templates and Tailwind CSS
build_system: Composer + artisan. No asset pipeline beyond Tailwind (CDN or Vite — not confirmed). Run `php artisan` for all framework tasks.
test_framework: None present (no PHPUnit config, no tests/ directory populated). Verification is route listing + manual browser check.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `php artisan migrate` to apply new migrations. 2. Run `php artisan route:list` to confirm routes. 3. Open each module in browser (login required) and exercise create/edit/delete flows. Flash messages must appear on success/failure.
environment_constraints: WAMP64 on Windows. DB is MySQL via WAMP. Never restart PHP/Apache — file edits are picked up immediately. The existing staff_activities table has only id + timestamps; add columns via a new migration (do NOT modify the existing one). The existing users table has no role/status; add via new migration.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing controller patterns: validate in controller, use Rule::in() for enums, redirect with ->with('success', ...) on success. Views must use @include('layouts.farm-sidebar', ['active' => '<key>']) — not inline aside HTML. All new views must wrap in <x-app-layout>. Use <form method='POST'> with @method('DELETE') for destroys — no JS confirm required.
key_patterns: 1. Sidebar: shared partial at resources/views/layouts/farm-sidebar.blade.php. Pass ['active' => '<key>'] to highlight. Keys: dashboard, animals, inventory, milk-productions, sales, breedings, animal-health, reports, user-management, staff-activities, settings. 2. Active state: border-l-4 border-amber-300 bg-[#285b43] font-semibold text-white. 3. breedings/index and animals/index already use the partial (pattern to follow). user-management/index and staff-activities/index still use inline sidebars — must be replaced with @include. 4. Validation pattern: $validated = $request->validate([...]) then Model::create($validated) or $model->update($validated). 5. Flash: session('success') and session('error') shown at top of page body. 6. Pagination: ->paginate(N)->withQueryString(). 7. User model uses PHP 8 attribute #[Fillable] — add role and status to that attribute array.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/ — all controllers. app/Models/ — Eloquent models. resources/views/<module>/ — Blade views per module (breedings, milk-productions, sales, animal-health, staff-activities, user-management, animals, inventory, layouts). database/migrations/ — 11 existing migrations. routes/web.php — single route file.
